answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The yarrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the kernel. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the marble is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
